newsitem.title: SYRIA: UAE backed by Arab ministers in dispute with Iran.
newsitem.headline: UAE backed by Arab ministers in dispute with Iran.

text.p: The foreign ministers of eight Arab countries on Thursday renewed their support for the United Arab Emirates in its dispute with Iran over ownership of three small islands in the Gulf.

The ministers of the so-called Damascus Declaration, grouping Syria, Egypt, and six Gulf Arab states, concluding talks in this resort urged Iran "to end its occupation of the islands and to resort to peaceful means to solve the dispute."
The final communique issued by the ministers aftr a two-day meeting reiterated their support for UAE sovereignty over islands Greater and Smaller Tunb and Abu Musa.

The ministers however expressed satisfaction over statements made by Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani and President-elect Mohammad Khatami calling for opening a new chapter in Arab-Iranian ties.
Iran, which has good ties with Syria, had criticised similar statements by the Damascus Declaration countries in previous meetings.
